objective: Correct the six independently reproduced CW-12 concurrency, cancellation, rebind-state, and FIFO journal defects.
must_fix: Make pause status/admission one linearized fence: when the coordinator is observably paused, no fresh CW-11 review ticket may dispatch. Preserve already-started dispatch semantics and avoid lock-order deadlock.
Serialize dispatch_automatic authority check and action start so a pause either follows an already-started action or holds it; no action may begin after pause linearizes.

Observe exact persisted run cancellation before every status/automation/automatic dispatch boundary, durably record it once, close automation even without a prior pause, preserve artifacts, and distinguish cancellation from pause/abort completion.
Reset all per-run acknowledgement, abort, unknown-tool, timestamp, cancellation, and persistence fields when binding a genuinely different clean run; fail closed on mismatched existing journal.
Open journal read targets nonblocking, fstat and reject FIFO/device/socket/directory without hangs; preserve symlink and append safety.
Make all 15 independent policy tests and existing focused/status/regression suites pass without weakening assertions.
constraints: Production correction only inside assigned policy/status scope; do not edit independent tests, G3/workflow/observation/contracts, tickets, PLAN, or workflow records.
Apply_patch only, no destructive git, no uv/local environment artifacts; run graphify update . after changes.
report: root cause and correction per finding
